title.narrative: INCLUSIRIGHTS: UNITING FOR EQUALITY AND JUSTICE

description.narrative: LGBTQI+ human rights in Nigeria have significantly deteriorated with same-sex relations prohibited. The Same-Sex Marriage (Prohibition) Act enacted in 2014 further compounds the challenges faced by the LGBTQI+ community, criminalizing same-sex marriage and public displays of affection between same-sex individuals, with severe penalties of up to 10 years in prison for involvement in LGBTQI+ clubs and organizations. Additionally, there has been a surge in mass arrests and detention of LGBTQI+ individuals without proper investigations, further exposing them to danger in the face of anti-LGBTQ+ sentiments. WHER would therefore want to create a safe space and protective visibility for LGBTQI+ groups within Nigeria during the 16 Days activism programme.
